# crosswork_performance_policies (Resource)

This resource can manage a performance monitoring policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_performance_policies" "example" {
  name            = "cwtest-policy"
  policy_template = "deviceHealth"
  description     = "Test policy"
  contact         = "noc@example.com"
  active          = true
  device_groups   = ["2661ed2d-11fb-49c4-9f9f-f71f1c12767b"]
  schema_intervals = [
    {
      schema  = "CPU"
      seconds = 600
    }
  ]
  thresholds = {
    "cpuUtilization" = {
      conditions = [
        {
          relation = "GE"
          value    = "90"
          count    = 2
          severity = "CRITICAL"
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Policy name, 1 to 255 characters
- `policy_template` (String) Policy type, for example `deviceHealth` or `INTERFACE`
- `schema_intervals` (Attributes Set) Polling intervals by schema, one row for each schema of the policy type (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schema_intervals))

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the policy collects data
  - Default value: `true`
- `contact` (String) Contact written into the tag of the policy
- `description` (String) Policy description
- `device_groups` (Set of String) Ids of the device groups to poll
- `devices` (Set of String) Devices to poll, by their inventory id; set one of `devices`, `device_groups` and `port_groups`
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `port_groups` (Set of String) Ids of the port groups to poll
- `thresholds` (Attributes Map) Thresholds by metric, for example `cpuUtilization` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--thresholds))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--schema_intervals"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schema_intervals`

Required:

- `schema` (String) Schema of the policy type, for example `CPU`
- `seconds` (Number) Polling interval in seconds, 0 for no polling


<a id="nestedatt--thresholds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `thresholds`

Required:

- `conditions` (Attributes List) Conditions of the metric, in order (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--thresholds--conditions))

<a id="nestedatt--thresholds--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `thresholds.conditions`

Required:

- `count` (Number) Number of polls that must match before the alarm is raised
- `relation` (String) Comparison of the metric with the value
  - Choices: `EQ`, `GT`, `GE`, `LT`, `LE`
- `severity` (String) Severity of the alarm, `INFORMATION` raises an event
  - Choices: `CRITICAL`, `MAJOR`, `MINOR`, `WARNING`, `INFORMATION`
- `value` (String) Value of the threshold

Optional:

- `match_cos` (Set of Number) Classes of service of a Quality of service drop metric, 0 to 7

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_performance_policies.example "<id>"
```
